dimensions.assessment: Affects federal research agencies, data center operators, researchers, and energy/water utilities.
dimensions.evidence: Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology... shall carry out a measurement research program

dimensions.assessment: Establishes measurement best practices, metrics, and standards without mandating operational changes for private data centers.
dimensions.evidence: inform the development or improvement of best practices, definitions, methodologies, procedures, and technical standards

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $10 million per year for fiscal years 2027 through 2029.
dimensions.evidence: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Director to carry out this section $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2029.

dimensions.assessment: Directs a federal research and standard-setting program with interagency and international coordination.
dimensions.evidence: Coordinate with international partners, including international standards organizations, to maintain global data center energy measurement standards.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes funding over a three-year period with ongoing standards maintenance.
dimensions.evidence: $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2029

missing_information: Specific long-term administrative costs beyond the authorized appropriations.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs NIST to establish a measurement research program for data center energy and water use, authorizes $10 million annually for three fiscal years, and requires briefings to Congress.
